## Suggested tags schema

Frontmatter (or first-line register) on every living doc:

```yaml
status: live | draft | archived
role: product | eng | design | ops | research | identity
spine: exists | where | how | want | do | start   # optional, 0–2
register: product | vision | rubric | language | agents | implementation | inspiration  # vision/product only
updated: YYYY-MM-DD
owner: human | agent-session
```

**Rules**
- `status: live` ≤ ~25 files total (list above).
- Dated filenames (`2026-07-19-…`) default to `draft` then `archived` within 14 days unless promoted.
- Nested `package.json` under docs ⇒ not a doc; `status` N/A → relocate to `lab/`.
- `role: research` + UFO subject matter ≠ platform eng docs.
